label: Binary decision with grounded evidence

preamble_lines: Review every case in this packed {evidence_mode} packet.
Return only the required structured JSON.

calibration.oracle_meaning: Theoretical ceiling: perfect approve/reject judgments with exact evidence on frozen ground truth.

output_shape_hint: Return ONLY JSON. results length must equal case count. Each result needs case_id, title, decision (approve|reject). When decision is approve, include evidence { source_id, source_url, evidence_quote, confidence } with evidence_quote as an exact substring (≥10 chars) of source text. When reject, evidence may be null.
